mapper.insert: insert into student( student_no, account_no, consult_customer_no, student_school, student_grade, student_gender, student_etc ) values( #{studentNo}, #{accountNo}, #{consultCustomerNo}, #{studentSchool}, #{studentGrade}, #{studentGender}, #{studentEtc} )
mapper.select: select * from student s join parent_student ps on s.student_no = ps.student_no where s.account_no = #{accountNo}
mapper.update: update student set student_school = #{studentSchool}, student_grade = #{studentGrade}, student_utime = systimestamp where account_no = #{accountNo}
update student_link set link_expire = systimestamp where student_no = #{studentNo} and link_used_yn = 'N' and link_expire > systimestamp
mapper.insert: insert into student_link ( student_link_no, student_no, link_code, link_expire, link_used_yn, student_link_ctime ) values( #{studentLinkNo}, #{studentNo}, #{linkCode}, #{linkExpire}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP )
